The build.

Ferrari 458 Italia model by vicent091036, distributed with the Three.js car example. Materials adapted for this experience.

Rendering: Three.js (MIT). Geometry decoding: Google Draco (Apache 2.0). Original fictional circuit, environment, interface, and driving code created for APEX.

Independent interactive project. Not affiliated with Ferrari. Driving behavior is a simplified game model, not a vehicle simulation.
